name: Polar Bear
desc: Animals capable of surviving even in environments of extreme cold, possessing massive bodies and thick fur.\nDespite their massive size, Polar Bears are quite agile. They can jump between floes and are adept at silently tracking their prey, arguably making them the finest hunters on the tundra.\nAdept at combat, Polar Bears are never docile, and will never easily yield to other animals or humans. Thus, in certain regions of Snezhnaya, people regard Polar Bears as a symbol of strength.
